core_obligations: Establish essential surjectivity, fullness and faithfulness of the reduction functor (proof lines 2424-2439).
Show that the ideal is contained in the Jacobson radical (proof lines 2440-2441).
Lift the factorisation of the reduction of a monic polynomial (proof lines 2442-2447).
Use the equivalence to conclude that the lift is already defined over the ring (proof lines 2448-2450).
proof_roadmap: The three properties of the reduction functor (proof lines 2424-2439).
Lifting the factorisation and concluding henselian (proof lines 2442-2450).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a pair whose ideal is locally nilpotent, reduction modulo the ideal is an equivalence between the categories of etale algebras, and that the pair is henselian. The proof checks the three requirements for the equivalence: essential surjectivity by lifting etale algebras, fullness by the strong lifting property for smooth algebras, and faithfulness by an idempotent argument using the kernel of the multiplication map and local nilpotence. Henselianity is then verified by showing the ideal lies in the Jacobson radical and lifting factorisations of monic polynomials using the monic lifting lemma together with the equivalence just established.
